sections.heading: what this *isn't*
sections.body:
The thread's own resume line describes client listing work rather than a system audit, so the label and the contents have drifted apart — treat the title with suspicion. The one honest outcome on record is a not-absorbed verdict, which means the work exists but changed nothing.

Session ledgers keep only the last 10 files per session and are pruned at 7 days, so file counts are a floor, not a census. Sweeps persist their own record, so anything already swept is kept.
